name: Nocte Eternal
description:
About This Game

Discover Nocte Eternal, a challenging action-platformer with fast-paced, technical gameplay in a dark fantasy world. This demo offers a glimpse of the game's direction while it is still in development and does not reflect its final quality. We welcome your feedback and would love to discuss the game with you!

Take on the role of Ulrich von Rabenswacht in Nocte Eternal, a challenging 2D action-platformer set in a dark fantasy world. Battle your way through the cursed lands and castle of the ruthless Duchess Eleonora von Moravgrad, where an eternal night of terror awaits.

Fight deadly enemies, overcome diabolical traps and face fearsome bosses in a gothic adventure where every mistake can prove costly. With fast-paced action and technical combat, Nocte Eternal will put your reflexes, precision and mastery to the test.

Journey through dozens of levels and explore every corner to uncover their many secrets. Observation and exploration are essential: reaching the end of your adventure will require you to unravel the mysteries hidden throughout these cursed lands.

Choose your challenge with multiple difficulty modes, including particularly punishing settings designed for seasoned and hardcore players. Learn your enemies’ patterns, refine your movements and push your skills to their limits to survive the night.

Key Features:

• Challenging 2D action-platforming with fast-paced, technical gameplay.

• Use the Trident Chain: a retractable weapon that allows the player to perform the Catapult Move using rings to swing and propel themselves through the environment.

• A gothic dark fantasy world trapped in an eternal night.

• Dozens of levels filled with enemies, traps and secrets.

• Fearsome bosses that will put your mastery to the test.

• Essential exploration to uncover the secrets needed to progress.

• Multiple difficulty modes, including extreme challenges for hardcore players.

Regarding the demo: The game is still under development, so its content and quality will be improved as development progresses.
